purpose: Preregistered validation of the post-hoc default change made after WP31 (commit 'DEFAULT CHANGE (post-hoc after WP31)': sampler::Tuning::default() U-turn rule Endpoints -> MomentumSum, and Adaptation::DualAveraging / Adaptation::Paper regularise the adapted diagonal metric with DiagonalMetricRegularization::Stan) on the posteriordb_bench_v3 protocol: identical model set, gates, estimators, chains/iterations, competitor versions and settings; fresh seeds; the harness rebuilt against the flipped src/; arms owalnuts-da (the new defaults), cmdstan, nutpie. The decision to flip was taken before this study, on the evidence of STUDIES/joint_default_v1, whose preregistered rule was NOT met (C2 failed on hmm_drive_0's arm-dependent second-mode draw and on the centered eight schools, which no arm passes). This study does not decide the flip; it measures it against the competitors on fresh seeds and reports the preregistered predictions as held or not.

predecessor.artifacts_reused: summary.json read only for the v3-vs-v5 comparison table; the v3 compiled models no longer exist. The BridgeStan libraries, the CmdStan executables and the posteriordb checkout are COPIED from the wt/posteriordb-v4 worktree (STUDIES/posteriordb_bench_v4/models, same BridgeStan 2.9.0 / Stan 2.39.0 / CmdStan 2.39.0 toolchain, no STAN_THREADS, posteriordb commit 28f8d3d), never modified there; mcycle_gp-accel_gp was not compiled in that worktree and is compiled here by the driver with the same flags. The venv is a copy of the v4 venv (Python 3.11.16, bridgestan 2.9.0, nutpie 0.16.8, cmdstanpy 1.3.0, arviz 0.23.4).
predecessor.decision_study: STUDIES/joint_default_v1 (WP31, seeds 86101-86103): joint / da 1.508 geomean min-bulk-ESS/gradient over 17 models, 41 vs 35 cells, funnel |z| <= 2 at both tunings, Eight Schools 1.29x; joint 0.477x the cited v3 CmdStan medians per gradient, 0.424x nutpie per gradient, ESS/s 1.56x the default arm's

kernel_under_test.api: owalnuts::sampler (Sampler, Init::uniform(), Tuning::default(), Metric::diagonal(), Adaptation::default()); harness src/main.rs identical to v3 except the recorded u_turn / metric_regularization fields and the schema name

sampler_defaults_under_test.metric_regularization: sampler::DEFAULT_METRIC_REGULARIZATION = DiagonalMetricRegularization::Stan (applied by Adaptation::DualAveraging and Adaptation::Paper)
sampler_defaults_under_test.unchanged: h0 0.5, depth 10, min_micro_steps 1, eight refinement levels (WP28), delta 1, divergence threshold 1000, retained exhaustion rule Stop, DEFAULT_WARMUP_EXHAUSTION = AcceptUnlessDivergent (WP24), dual averaging 0.8, adapted diagonal metric from the identity, cached initial evaluation, Limits::admit_worst_case()
sampler_defaults_under_test.source: STUDIES/joint_default_v1 (WP31); the flip commit is the parent of the commit that freezes this protocol

owalnuts-da.target: owalnuts-bridgestan ReplicatedStanTarget, 4 replicas (BridgeStan 2.9.0, Stan 2.39.0, built WITHOUT STAN_THREADS)
owalnuts-da.starts: sampler::Init::uniform(): uniform(-2,2) unconstrained, redrawn up to 100 times until finite density and gradient; SmallRng(splitmix64(seed ^ INIT_SEED_TAG))

nutpie.backend: bridgestan (nutpie.compile_stan_model; nutpie builds its own STAN_THREADS library)

seeds_verified_unused: grep -w over wiki/, STUDIES/ (README, protocol, PREREGISTRATION, *.py, src/), src/, tests/, examples/ before freezing: no occurrence as a seed (85101-85103 were consumed by funnel_bias_fix_v1, 86101-86103 by joint_default_v1)
run_order: models in listed order; arms owalnuts-da, cmdstan, nutpie; seeds ascending; strictly sequential; then the funnel row
parameter_set: columns of the posteriordb reference draws; oWALNUTS draws constrained by BridgeStan param_constrain(include_tp=True)
estimators: arviz 0.23.4: rank rhat; bulk ESS; tail ESS prob (0.05, 0.95); mcse method mean

metrics.gradients_total: owalnuts target calls (start search + warmup + sampling, all chains); cmdstan sum n_leapfrog__ (warmup+sampling); nutpie sum n_steps (warmup+sampling)
metrics.wall: seconds around the single sampler call (Sampler::run, CmdStanModel.sample, nutpie.sample), warmup included, compile excluded; the oWALNUTS start search (a handful of evaluations) is outside the wall
metrics.wall_sampling_estimated: wall * gradients_sampling / gradients_total (all arms); cmdstan CSV elapsed times also recorded
metrics.ess_per_second: min over parameters of bulk (tail) ESS / wall
metrics.ess_per_gradient: min over parameters of bulk (tail) ESS / gradients_total; sampling-only variant also reported
metrics.agreement: z = (mean - mean_ref)/sqrt(mcse^2 + mcse_ref^2) with arviz mean MCSE on both sides; max |z| over parameters; flag if > 4
metrics.frozen_chain: an oWALNUTS chain with more than 500 of its 1,000 retained transitions ending in refinement exhaustion; a cell is frozen if any chain is
metrics.installed_mass: per chain max and min of the final diagonal mass (the WP31 floor diagnostic), recorded

head_to_head: per competitor: geometric mean over models with all seeds ok on both sides of the seed-median ratios of min bulk ESS/gradient, min bulk ESS/s and wall per gradient; wins counted per model; 'outright win' = gates passed >= competitor and higher seed-median ESS/gradient and ESS/s

funnel.target: Neal's 10-D funnel, omega ~ N(0, 9), x_i | omega ~ N(0, e^omega); exact P(omega < -5) = 0.0478
funnel.tuning: the sampler defaults, nothing overridden: Tuning::default() (MomentumSum, eight levels), Metric::diagonal() (Stan regularisation), Adaptation::default(), threads 4 — the joint_default_v1 'defaults / joint' cell on fresh seeds
funnel.statistic: per seed: z = (estimate - exact) / MCSE of the indicator omega < -5 (owalnuts::diagnostics::mcse_mean, the funnel_defaults_v1 statistic); the gate is |z| <= 2 on every seed. The batch-means z per seed and pooled is reported alongside

predictions.P1: owalnuts-da passes all gates on >= 39 of 51 cells (v3 default arm 35; WP31 joint arm 41 on seeds 86101-86103; CmdStan 37 and nutpie 31 in v3)
predictions.P2: owalnuts-da geometric-mean min-bulk-ESS/gradient vs CmdStan >= 0.45 over all 17 models (v3 default 0.344; WP31 joint against the cited v3 CmdStan medians 0.477)
predictions.P3: owalnuts-da geometric-mean min-bulk-ESS/second vs nutpie >= 1.5 over the models complete on both sides (v3 default 1.35; WP31 joint ESS/s 1.56x the default arm's)
predictions.P4: owalnuts-da geometric-mean wall per gradient <= 1.0x CmdStan (v3: 0.751)
predictions.P5: funnel tail mass at the sampler defaults: |z| <= 2 on every one of the three seeds (WP31 joint at the defaults: -0.06, +0.81, -1.16)

reported_not_gated: v5 / v3 seed-median ratios per model and arm (the DA arm's geomean is expected near WP31's 1.51x; cmdstan and nutpie are the seed-noise control); models below 0.8x or above 1.2x v3 for the DA arm; frozen cells; cells not ok; installed mass ranges; final steps and depth caps per seed; outright wins against each competitor
decision_rules: Report all cells; no reruns; failures are results; nothing tuned after seeing results. A driver crash is relaunched and the interrupted cell re-run from scratch (seeded), recorded as a deviation. The default change is NOT reversed by this study on its own: it was a post-hoc decision documented as such; the study reports which predictions held. If P1, P2 and P4 all hold the release notes may cite this run as the breadth figure for the 0.2.0 defaults; if P2 or P5 fails, the release notes must say so next to the numbers.
machine_note: shared machine; other worktrees may run concurrently; walls and ESS/s are upper bounds / reported, ESS per gradient is the robust metric
